description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CommandConfiguration' for setting up command processing using the Disruptor library within the Apache Fineract project. It includes bean definitions for wait strategy and disruptor setup, with conditional annotations based on project properties.

classes.name: CommandConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up command disruptor with conditional beans and component scanning.

methods.name: waitStrategy
methods.description: Defines the wait strategy bean, returning a YieldingWaitStrategy if the property 'fineract.command.executor' is set to 'disruptor'.

methods.name: disruptor
methods.description: Creates and configures a Disruptor instance for command event processing, setting event handlers and exception handling, then starts it.
